entries.title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
entries.summary: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time.
entries.why: 31 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.AI

entries.title: Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation of RL Experts: Toward Continual Post-Training
entries.summary: RL post-training typically produces domain experts that must then be consolidated into one model, and as new experts keep arriving, this consolidation becomes a continual process.

entries.title: Self-WSP: Can Language Models Improve Themselves Through Weight-Space Programming?
entries.summary: Frontier language models can now read and edit the weights of a neural network much like code and thereby improve a small model, an approach known as Weight-Space Programming (WSP). We further explore applying WSP to a language model itself, which we call Self-WSP.
entries.why: 10 upvotes on HF Papers; also on arXiv cs.CL
